newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were generally stable in late trading on Tuesday with no known buying interest, traders said.
"Prices are generally stable this afternoon and we didn't hear any fresh deals. But market sentiment has improved due to rises overseas and tight domestic supply," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 48.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for August shipment, 48.25 fob Palembang, 48.25-50 fob Padang and Surabaya and 47.75 fob Pontianak.
